nodes.title: MiCA - Data Protection Requirements
nodes.description: MiCA Article 78 requires CASPs to comply with GDPR for processing personal data in crypto-asset services

nodes.title: MiCA - Complaints Handling Procedures
nodes.description: MiCA Article 71 requires CASPs to establish effective complaints handling procedures, free of charge, with reasonable timeframes

nodes.title: MiCA - Outsourcing Requirements
nodes.description: MiCA Article 73 sets rules for CASPs outsourcing operational functions, requiring competent authority notification and maintaining responsibility

nodes.title: MiCA - ICT Security Requirements
nodes.description: MiCA Article 72 requires CASPs to have ICT security systems and protocols in compliance with DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act)

nodes.title: MiCA - Conflict of Interest Prevention
nodes.description: MiCA Article 72 requires CASPs to identify, prevent, manage and disclose conflicts of interest

nodes.title: MiCA - Record Keeping
nodes.description: MiCA Article 68 requires CASPs to maintain records of all services, activities and orders for 5 years

nodes.title: MiCA - Prudential Safeguards
nodes.description: MiCA Article 67 requires CASPs to have prudential safeguards equal to at least the higher of EUR 150,000 or one quarter of fixed overheads

nodes.title: MiCA - Prohibition of Insider Dealing
nodes.description: MiCA Title VI prohibits insider dealing, unlawful disclosure of inside information and market manipulation for crypto-assets

nodes.title: MiCA - Crypto-Asset White Paper
nodes.description: MiCA Article 6 requires publication of a white paper for crypto-assets offered to the public, with standardized content requirements

key_values.requirement: standardized white paper for public offerings

nodes.title: MiCA - Environmental Sustainability Disclosure
nodes.description: MiCA requires CASPs to disclose information on principal adverse environmental and climate-related impacts of crypto-asset consensus mechanisms
